item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00320","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C23","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives respond to economic weakness by accelerating already approved urban-renewal construction through the Housing and Home Finance Agency, removing administrative obstacles, coordinating with local officials, and commencing construction at the earliest feasible time. The child's short appeal to mayors adapts C02's detailed agency instructions into a public request for reciprocal local action. C23 strongly reinforces the same economic rationale and acceleration policy, while C16 is a broader precedent for channeling federal construction activity to alleviate unemployment, but neither matches the child's specific urban-renewal machinery as closely as C02.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"there are many projects now underway or whose final plans have been approved in many cities that can be speeded up creating additional jobs immediately","parent_excerpt":"This large volume of essential construction should be accelerated. To this end, top priority should be given in the operations of your agency to urban renewal activities","explanation":"Both identify planned or approved urban-renewal construction as work that can be accelerated for immediate economic effect."},{"child_excerpt":"I have directed the Housing and Home Finance Agency officials in Washington and in regional offices to eliminate all delay","parent_excerpt":"you should undertake, in cooperation with the governing officials of applicant institutions, to assure that there is no avoidable delay in the commencement of construction","explanation":"The child closely reuses the distinctive administrative command to eliminate avoidable delay in starting construction."},{"child_excerpt":"to cooperate with local authorities in beginning construction of these projects at the earliest possible time","parent_excerpt":"in cooperation with local officials, take all reasonable and feasible steps to see that any obstacles remaining are eliminated and that construction of such projects is promptly begun","explanation":"The same federal-local mechanism is used: cooperate with local officials, remove obstacles, and promptly begin construction."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge you to do everything within your ability to eliminate delay and I promise you the full cooperation of the Federal Government","parent_excerpt":"Where local public or private construction is to be undertaken with federal financial assistance, you should take all necessary steps to assure that such assistance is available when required and that the necessary construction is undertaken at the earliest feasible and appropriate time.","explanation":"The child converts the earlier agency-facing assurance of timely federal support into a mayor-facing promise of federal cooperation."}]}
